column1: # Stocks of one machine: the places where things accumulate, and who can empty each.
# Copy to STATE/stocks.tsv and replace the example rows. Columns are separated by tabs.
# path     an absolute folder, or PREFIX/**/NAME for every folder called NAME below PREFIX
# empties  rules  = a cleanup run can, by evidence (finished work, build output, caches)
#          owner  = only the owner decides (history, data awaiting a decision, personal content)
# The most specific row wins. Everything unlisted is reported as "outside stocks".
